acceptance_tests.gap: Riesz contour and Green inverse require a positive gap with error bounds.
acceptance_tests.no_proxy_fit: Observed SM masses, mixings, or benchmark rows cannot select or tune the packet.
acceptance_tests.non_identity: rho_E cannot be the identity smoke packet or only a trace scalar.
acceptance_tests.operator_equations: D_E, Riesz, Green, dotD, and C1 tensors must satisfy the existing validators without lifted source flags.
acceptance_tests.projective_cocycle: transition matrices must satisfy the selected central-cocycle law and the S3 restriction table.
acceptance_tests.same_source: Every emitted value must cite the same q79/F,m=1 selected S3/GS/Phi_fin branch.

must_emit_same_source_payload: non-identity projective rho_E transition matrices on the selected projective B_N basis
finite connection/metric tables compatible with the selected S3 Deligne class and visible GS row
covariant D_E matrices sector by sector in the same basis
Riesz projectors defined by the selected spectral contour with an explicit positive complement gap
reduced Green operators with norm and truncation/error certificates
dotD_alpha1 matrices obtained as the same-branch derivative of the emitted D_E package
ordered zero-mode bases and coherent spectral projectors retained under the selected S3 block action
primitive C1 contractions computed from the emitted zero modes, Green response, and dotD payload
